items.title: Woody Marks: Finds paydirt in preseason loss
items.description:
Marks rushed four times for 37 yards and a touchdown while catching his only target for six yards in Thursday's 22-20 preseason loss to the Raiders.

items.title: Kirk Cousins: Kubiak not yet ready to name starting QB
items.description:
Coach Klint Kubiak refused to name Cousins as the Raiders' starting quarterback following Thursday night's preseason game against the Texans, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Leads TD drive in brief outing
items.description:
Stroud completed four of six passes for 27 yards in Thursday's 22-20 preseason loss to the Raiders.

items.title: Fernando Mendoza: Tosses pick-six in first start
items.description:
Mendoza completed eight of 15 passes for 86 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Thursday's 22-20 preseason win over the Texans.

items.title: George Kittle: Has chance to play Week 1
items.description:
Kittle (Achilles) visited with Dr. Neal ElAttrache on Wednesday and remains ahead of schedule in his recovery with a chance to play Week 1 against the Rams, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
